name: Yawara Rheumatology
description: Yawara Rheumatology is a calm, daylight-inspired WordPress theme designed for rheumatology practices and specialized medical clinics. Built with a signature half-and-half hero screen, drifting photographic strip, seam tab cards, and a narrative-problem-method-proof structure, it presents clinical care with quiet clarity. The theme combines Figtree and Public Sans typography with accessible, content-focused block patterns and refined responsive layouts.
